title: Add Gaussian parity proofs and mixed-center community integration
body:
This adds an exact arithmetic and precision integration for the community's actual mixed-center producer. Starting from arbitrary dirty scalar ports, subtracting old/new values before division and collecting the side corrections produces an integer-only reference decoder. The completed-child denominator certificate is then applied to the pinned 29-class PR46 profile. The result includes a paper, 168 Lean theorem declarations, executable interfaces, source-pinned audits, and provenance.

The new standalone package is [`research/gaussian-parity-synthesis/`](https://github.com/alejandrozu/integer-mult-bounds/tree/gaussian-parity-certificates/research/gaussian-parity-synthesis). The earlier 69-theorem package in `research/gaussian-parity/` is retained unchanged.

Entry points: [paper PDF](https://github.com/alejandrozu/integer-mult-bounds/blob/gaussian-parity-certificates/research/gaussian-parity-synthesis/community-parity-synthesis.pdf), [LaTeX source](https://github.com/alejandrozu/integer-mult-bounds/blob/gaussian-parity-certificates/research/gaussian-parity-synthesis/community-parity-synthesis.tex), [reproduction/interface README](https://github.com/alejandrozu/integer-mult-bounds/blob/gaussian-parity-certificates/research/gaussian-parity-synthesis/README.md), [formalization map](https://github.com/alejandrozu/integer-mult-bounds/blob/gaussian-parity-certificates/research/gaussian-parity-synthesis/FORMALIZATION_MAP.md), [community ledger](https://github.com/alejandrozu/integer-mult-bounds/blob/gaussian-parity-certificates/research/gaussian-parity-synthesis/LEDGER.md), and [provenance](https://github.com/alejandrozu/integer-mult-bounds/blob/gaussian-parity-certificates/research/gaussian-parity-synthesis/PROVENANCE.md).

## Combined result

The source inventory covers all 46 PRs available at the start of this run, with pinned heads and 5,380 cumulative changed-file records, plus Swapnil Jain's separate Round 6 work. The concrete integration targets PR46 at `71b6c960c89295e952522dd44111df9cfc51ae90`, which retains the mixed-center/copied-center chain, changed-DAG and fixed-basis work, reversed geometry, PR44's weighted matching, and direct rational data recovery. These overlapping contributions are not treated as independently additive improvements. The inventory does not claim every community build was executed.

- **Exact dirty-port scalar decoder:** for the actual h28,d19 producer, `sum delta B - 2 sum delta D = -32 T`; the remaining collected numerators are `2 X`. The fused reference schedule needs zero additional fractional bits versus six in the explicitly compared generic old/new reference schedule. Gaussian quotient calls decrease from 26,268 to 3,286 in those schedules, excluding the optional image check and physical frame costs. These are reference-arithmetic counts, not measured runtime or optimality claims.
- **Complete image guard and usable adapter:** local divisibility is insufficient. `checked_fused_delta` checks `P(Q delta)==delta`, rejecting locally divisible off-image examples. `mixed_center_adapter.py` connects canonical, heterogeneous Gaussian tags to the actual integer producer/decoder at an explicitly promised common input grid. All center and side ports must share one phase frame; matching phases within individual roles is insufficient.
- **Actual-profile precision certificate:** the 29 complex child classes have old completed-child charge `421548223824*f`. Their certified charge is `(421548223824*f + 1142904672*(f mod 2))/2`, bounded by `211345564248*f` for every natural parallel width. This reduces that component by **49.864439629%**. Scalar E, global guard, unfinished recursion, tape/memory costs, normalized H0 output and the multiplication exponent are separately charged and unchanged by this certificate.
- **Formal tensor execution:** `GaussianTensorExecution.lean` defines and executes the full finite recursive C tensor in every dimension. It proves tagged forward/inverse restoration, the terminal `p+ceil(D/2)` binary grid, odd-depth parity and sharpness using an actually executed impulse. This closes the earlier written-only execution link for that finite tensor algorithm; it does not certify physical frame/tape compilation.

The mixed-center inverse identity and Gaussian parity principles are inherited mathematics. The contribution is their combined exact dirty-difference implementation, guarded concrete producer integration, all-dimensional finite tensor execution proof, and source-linked actual-profile accounting.

## Authorship and provenance

**Alejandro Zarzuelo Urdiales** is the author and human developer. This research began in an earlier **Archivara** exploration of parity-aware integer multiplication. Alejandro subsequently developed the line personally with multiple AI tools, most recently **GPT-6.1**, as recorded by the author. This synthesis, paper, Lean proofs, controls and submission preparation involved substantial **OpenAI Codex** assistance.

The earlier exploration supplies the parity motivation. The arithmetic used here has independent proofs; this submission does not inherit its broader separation, carry-saving or benchmark assertions.

The package credits OpenAI's pinned manuscript; Douglas Colkitt/CrocSwap; icekylinx; Zhihao Chen/jacklightChen; RaD/hipotures; Aurel Prosz/Paureel; James Chang/jamesyc; Dominik Scholz; Rohan Arun; Chafik Boukhalfa/chafreaky; Swapnil Jain; and the contributors and AI disclosures retained in the upstream NOTICE and complete ledger. Gaussian denominator exponents and parity reduction are established prior work in Amy, Glaudell and Ross, Quantum 4, 252 (2020), section 5.4. No priority claim is made for these inherited principles or identities. New material is Apache-2.0; vendored source retains its original LICENSE, NOTICE and exact bytes.

## Validation and limits

- Lean 4.31.0, bundled Std only: five proof modules and the complete 168-theorem axiom audit pass `lake build`; **99 theorem declarations are new** beyond the earlier package. Dependencies are standard Lean foundational axioms only, with no omitted proofs, project axioms or `native_decide`.
- Four standalone Python audits pass. The actual producer audit checks all **10,732,176 source/target coefficients** using exact integer bitplanes, six all-target dirty trials and negative image/frame controls. Two additional canonical-tag adapter trials exercise all 3,276 sources and 13,132 dirty ports with heterogeneous tags. The profile is checked against the full vendored pinned certificate before its arithmetic is used. Modified pinned source and optimized Python assertion execution are rejected.
- The phase/oracle controls include 729 canonical cases, 10,000 heterogeneous pairs, 15,000 operations and 10,752 exact phase-endpoint values. The all-width charge is a Lean theorem, supplemented by finite controls.
- The four-page PDF compiles with Tectonic and every rendered page was inspected. All staged artifact hashes match the included manifest.
- The original package's checks and 188 upstream unit tests passed in the earlier commit. The upstream full generator/integration `make verify` was **not** rerun for this addition.

The concrete finite producer link is independently checked by Python; Lean proves the generic image-interface contract and the finite recursive tensor, not a full Python refinement or physical network compiler. Analytic/recovery premises, fixed-tape schedules, full multiplication theorem, physical runtime and any new kappa remain outside the demonstrated result.

Reproduce offline with `cd research/gaussian-parity-synthesis && make verify`, or use `verify.ps1` with Lean 4.31.0 and Python 3.10+ on PATH. Vendored runtime dependencies and exact source hashes are included; no upstream checkout or third-party Python package is required.
